name: Sakurai Kazushi
source:
Kazushi is the protagonist of the game. He enjoys spending his weekend with his two best friends, playing video games and exchanging their porn magazines. He is kind of cool and not very sucky. The stress ? He doesn't know that. Bad student and a noob in love, he wants to quit his studies as soon as he graduates to sell bikes.

He has fallen in love with his classmate [url=https://vndb.org/c69933]Yui[/url] since the first time he saw her but does not dare to confess to her because she is the best student in the class, appreciated by all her classmates. Moreover, Yui is always uncomfortable with him and doesn't seem to really like him.
When she summons him to class after club activities, he fears the worst for his ears ...
